company__culture__all-remote__meetings.md:37:1. **Adhere to the agenda order to ensure inclusiveness.** People may add agenda topics to the agenda asynchronously and synchronously during the meeting. In guiding discussions, ensure that agenda topics discussed are equitable and fair - don't let a single person or subset of the group monopolize the agenda at the expense of others.
engineering__architecture__design-documents__database_size_limits___index.md:157:For solutions like normalization, this is a trade-off: Denormalized models can speed up queries when used appropriately, at the expense of table size. When normalizing models, splitting tables or externalizing data, we aim to understand the impact on performance and strive to find a solution to reduce table sizes that doesn't impact performance significantly.
engineering__architecture__design-documents__scaling-git__clustering_routing.md:244:Redirects address these issues at the expense of extra client-side processing.
finance__accounting___index.md:206:1. Billing & Revenue team review AR Aging as on a monthly basis. Fifty (50) percent of the balances that are Ninety (90) days or more after the due date and One Hundred (100) percent of the balances that are One Hundred and Twenty (120) days or more after the due date are reserved as allowance for doubtful debt. Bad debt expense is recorded based on revenue recognised, future revenue recognition is stopped and deferred revenue is reversed all at the Netsuite level.
finance__accounting___index.md:207:1. Future amortisation of commissions expenses related to reserved invoices should also be stopped to ensure alignment with pattern of revenue recognition.
finance__accounting___index.md:255:1. Go to the "Expense and Items" tab below to enter the expense details.
finance__accounting___index.md:256:1. Select appropriate GL-account under the "Account" dropdown box. (Be sure to check whether the invoice represents a prepaid expense, fixed asset, etc.)
finance__accounting___index.md:259:1. Enter department. (This must be entered if the account you selected in step 6 is an expense account)
finance__accounting___index.md:350:1. Go to the "Expense and Items" tab below to enter the expense details.
finance__accounting___index.md:351:1. Select appropriate GL-account under the "Account" dropdown box. (Be sure to check whether the invoice represents a prepaid expense, fixed asset, etc.)
finance__accounting___index.md:354:1. Enter department. (This must be entered if the account you selected in step 6 is an expense account)
finance__accounting___index.md:363:**Billable Expenses**
finance__accounting___index.md:365:If you have an expense report that can be billed back to a customer please make sure to check the "billable" flag in Navan along with tagging the customer name under the "customer" field in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:441:## Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:443:Please refer to GitLab's [Expense Policy](../expenses/) for further details.
finance__accounting___index.md:445:### Team Member Reimbursements - Navan
finance__accounting___index.md:449:1. Navan will auto sync and record expense reports into NetSuite once the report is "final approved".  "Final approved" means it has been approved by the team member's manager and completed an audit review by an Accounts Payable analyst or our external contractor, Montgomery Pacific (Montpac).
finance__accounting___index.md:452:#### Billable Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:454:- If you have an expense report that can be billed back to a customer please make sure to check the "billable" flag in Navan along with tagging the customer name under the "customer" field in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:458:1. Team members in a US expense policy will be automatically reimbursed through Navan after their report is "final approved" within 1-4 business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:460:    - Once an team member is reimbursed, Navan will auto sync the payment to the expense record to mark the report as reimbursed.
finance__accounting___index.md:462:1. Team memebers in a country paid through PEO will also receive expense reimbursement through their same payroll PEO payments each month.
finance__accounting___index.md:463:    - **Please Note:**  The timing of reimbursement can vary if you are being reimbursed directly from payroll, CXC, SafeGuard, Global PEO, Remote and/or iiPay.
finance__accounting___index.md:464:    - More information on the timing of payouts can be found [here](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#44-reimbursement-payout-timelines)
finance__accounting___index.md:465:1. All non-US GitLab entities will be reimbursed through their respective payroll provider or paid directly through GitLab's Accounts Payable (AP) department with the normal weekly payment run.
finance__accounting___index.md:466:    - Expense report must have been "final approved" no later than EOD Tuesday of that same week.
finance__accounting___index.md:467:    - Any report "final approved" on Wednesday to Friday of that week will be reimbursed the following week.
finance__accounting___index.md:468:    - Once an employee is reimbursed, AP will create the payment in NetSuite against the record to close the report as paid.
finance__accounting___index.md:469:    - AP will manually mark the expense reports as "Reimbursed" in Navan once they are confirmed to the payroll provider or batched to Tipalti.
finance__accounting___index.md:477:    - Any team memebers hired after 2019-11-01 will be sent onboarding requests upon hire and/or upon first submission of an expense report.
finance__accounting___index.md:479:**Further details on the Expense reimbursement process can be found [here](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#4-procedures)**
finance__accounting___index.md:481:#### Accounts Payable Analyst Performance Indicators - Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:485:    Number of days from when an team member's manager approves report to when AP analyst does final approval for payment or responds to team member in Navan if there is a concern. (Approval for payment is not the reimbursement date.) This is calculated on a calendar month basis. The target for this is currently three business days.
finance__accounting___index.md:491:### Travel and Expense Guidelines
finance__accounting___index.md:496:Discretionary spending includes expenses like travel, conferences, gifts, bonuses, merit pay increases and summits.
finance__accounting___index.md:504:### Non-Reimbursable Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:506:In order to purchase goods and services on behalf of the company, you should first [consult the Signature Authorization Matrix](../authorization-matrix/) to determine the approval requirements. Note that this **does not** include travel expenses and other incidentals. These expenses should be self-funded then submitted for reimbursement within Navan, or in the case of independent contractors, included in invoices to the company (per the guidelines above).
finance__accounting___index.md:510:### Creation of Expense Tags
finance__accounting___index.md:512:If you would like to track spend for a particular campaign, project and/or event you can do that through expense tag, also known as classes in NetSuite.  If you would like to request an expense tag/class to be set up please open [this tracker](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wBqvCvmou4afnb0p8lBXVvFmsl-j0IehS7GdfJybGzg/edit?usp=sharing) and enter the information required for the General Ledger (GL) team to create the tag.
finance__accounting___index.md:521:1. Add the name of the expense tag under Name
finance__accounting___index.md:525:Navan will auto-sync any new "expense tags" on a daily basis, but if the Navan admin wants to manually sync they can do so by following these steps:
finance__accounting___index.md:541:### Contribute Costs and other key expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:543:#### Marketing Campaign Expenses
finance__accounting___index.md:545:Please see the [campaign expense guidelines in the Marketing handbook](/handbook/marketing/marketing-operations/).
finance__accounting___index.md:551:Tracking expenses for company Contributes enables us to analyze our spend and find opportunities to iterate, and in turn, improve subsequent Contributes. To enable tracking we create an expense tag that will allow GitLab team-members to tag Contribute related expenses in Navan. This should be done prior to the announcement of each Contribute.
finance__accounting___index.md:553:- To categorize an expense under an expense tag to track a specific marketing campaign, contribute expense and/or any special project you will do this under the "classifications" tag in Navan.
finance__accounting___index.md:573:GitLab establishes [$5,000 (USD)](/handbook/total-rewards/compensation/#exchange-rates) as the minimum amount required for capitalization. Any item with a cost below this amount is expensed on the date of purchase. Exceptions are Key Component Assets (i.e. computer laptops).

content.text: Finance's target is to give final approval (or respond with a concern) within three business days of your manager approving the report. After that, US team members are reimbursed through Navan within 1–4 business days. Payment timing for non-US team members varies by payroll provider or follows the weekly AP payment run (source: `finance__accounting___index.md`).
